summary: All four files in this work unit contain substantial formal mathematical content — definitions, theorem statements, and proofs — directly formalizing key results from cited papers. CrossProductRigidity.lean proves cross-product rigidity theorems for injective and normal matrix families (arXiv:2502.20257). FiniteLength.lean implements the finite-length Fundamental Theorem of MPS with trace agreement and downward induction (Pérez-García et al., Sanz et al., Wolf). MultiBlockDirectSum.lean provides the direct-sum infrastructure for the multi-block asymmetric compression theorem (P5 note Theorem 7.7). WordModule.lean defines the word-algebra module of a tensor and proves normality implies simplicity (P5 note Lemma 7.4). None are pure import aggregators; all contain original formal mathematics.
